what: C5 · source scorecard (2 Oct 2026) · the four comp-set sources measured on every served company with a comp set · read-only, nothing deployed
rule: the standard's rule, unchanged: same industry by the authority (FMP industry, or the same SIC) → market value inside ÷10…×10 (widened to ×30, then any, when fewer than 5 survive) → ranked by votes then closeness → the nearest 10 kept

verdict.sentence: Massive's related companies is the sharpest (49% of the served names it offers end in the kept ten), FMP's peer list just behind (47%); when the two lists agree on a name it is kept 85% of the time. A shared industry fund is the widest net (28 names per company on average) and mostly noise: 17% of its names are kept and 72% are in another industry. The same industry is the gate, not a voter: every kept name is in it by construction, and 711 of the 3,061 kept (23%) were found by it alone — names no list and no fund offered. FMP's list reaches furthest outside the Hub (55% of its names have no figures here, against 37% for Massive); Massive is missing for 61 companies and 136 of the 138 served funds.
